dedupe_keys.name: san francisco street tree inventory datasf

description: The San Francisco Street Tree Inventory lists every street tree recorded in the city's inventory, one row per tree, excluding empty basins, landscaping areas, potential planting sites and removed trees. San Francisco Public Works extracts it daily from its asset management system and publishes it on DataSF; the dataset was rebuilt in place in September 2026 after a move to a new asset system in December 2024, with the earlier Street Tree List archived. Fields include tree id, legal status, species, site information, plant type, planter, watering responsibility, planted date, trunk diameter and range, plot size, coordinates, supervisor district, neighbourhood and street location. Coverage is the City and County of San Francisco. Format and access: Socrata exports (CSV, GeoJSON) and API. Licence: Open Data Commons PDDL; free. Caveats: not all trees have coordinates, precision varies, records change only when crews touch a tree, and emergency removals may be missing. It supports urban heat, stormwater and storm-damage exposure studies and green infrastructure planning. Related catalogue records are the NYC 2015 Street Tree Census and Boston's BPRD tree inventory.
